detailed_description:
The target video is an 18-second cinematic pop music video in 2.39:1 at 24fps, with shallow depth of field, fine film grain, backlit rim light, and a fashion-editorial mood; every on-screen vocal is syllable-by-syllable lip-synced to the driving audio.
[Shot 1] A dark concert stage: one hard spotlight falls from above on <Subject 1>, eyes closed, holding a vintage microphone to her lips in a hazy beam of warm gold. The camera slowly dollies in on her lips and the mic. Her mouth forms the opening syllables, jaw soft and relaxed, a small visible breath lifting between phrases as she sings <d>[Chinese]街灯把影子拉得好长</d>. 85mm, shallow focus, gentle rim light on her ponytail.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, a hard cut to a rainy night street: blue-purple neon and warm-orange signs bleed into the wet asphalt. <Subject 1> walks slowly toward camera while singing, handheld camera swaying slightly, neon reflections sliding under her feet. Her mouth opens cleanly on each syllable, chin lifting as she sings <d>[Chinese]你回头 嘴角微微上扬</d>, her own lips then curling into a faint smile; 35mm, shallow focus, neon flickering across her cheeks.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, a white-flash cut to a warm yellow recording studio: <Subject 1> wears over-ear headphones in side profile at a studio microphone, her finger tapping gently against the pop filter. The camera pushes from a close-up of her tapping hand up along her arm to her face; she sings in a breathy chest voice, lips rounding on each sustained vowel, jaw relaxed; 50mm, warm tungsten, shallow depth.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, jump cuts to the chorus, back on the spotlight stage: <Subject 1> tilts her head back and sings at full voice, mouth wide open on the high note, jaw dropping with each sustained syllable. The camera orbits 180 degrees around her as lights strobe on and off; only dark audience silhouettes fill the background. She sings <d>[Chinese]这一刻 时间都变慢</d>; wide lens, strong backlight, drifting haze catching the beams.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.500, a cut to a mirror space walled in reflective panels: every reflection of <Subject 1> sings the same held note, lips parted and breathing through the word in slow motion, cheeks lifting as the vowel sustains. Cold blue and warm-orange light interweave across her face; 50mm, slow-motion flow dissolved into 24fps, shallow focus on the nearest reflection.
[Shot 6] At 00:16.000, a black frame, then a facial extreme close-up: <Subject 1> opens her eyes and sings directly into camera, holding the final word, her mouth closing precisely on the final consonant. Lights dim to a thin rim on her silhouette; the camera slowly pulls back and freezes on her face as the last note fades; 85mm, fine film grain.

The driving pop ballad plays throughout: intimate stage room tone and a soft crowd hush under Shot 1 and Shot 4, faint wet-street drizzle and distant traffic under Shot 2, dry close-mic studio tone under Shot 3, and near-silence under the final close-up. No additional voices beyond the lead vocal.
